about: Where every text comes from. 'sources' are what ingest converts into res/; 'witnesses' are independent copies that the sources are checked against (npm run verify). Every download is pinned to a commit or release and checked against the SHA-256 recorded here. 'lineage' says where a copy itself came from: witnesses with the same lineage count as one vote. 'attestations' are facts a person checked that can't be established by comparing texts. See res/SOURCES.md.

kjv.title: King James Version
kjv.lineageNote: Upstream not stated; describes itself as the KJV 1769 text.

henry.title: Matthew Henry's Commentary on the Whole Bible
henry.lineageNote: Extracted from CrossWire's SWORD module MHC, which was prepared from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library text.
henry.license: Text public domain; the repository has no LICENSE file

strongs-greek.title: Strong's Greek Dictionary
strongs-greek.license: 1890 text public domain; Open Scriptures edition CC-BY-SA (credit required, share alike)

strongs-hebrew.title: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary
strongs-hebrew.license: 1890 text public domain; Open Scriptures edition CC-BY-SA (credit required, share alike)

kjv-pce.title: Pure Cambridge Edition of the KJV
kjv-pce.lineageNote: The Pure Cambridge Edition (c. 1900 Cambridge text), as prepared by Bible Protector.

kjv-scrollmapper.title: KJV in scrollmapper/bible_databases
kjv-scrollmapper.lineageNote: Same repository as kjv-pce but a different text: it differs from the PCE in hundreds of verses (spelling and word division).

kjv-ebible.title: eBible.org eng-kjv
kjv-ebible.lineageNote: eBible.org's KJV, a 1769-based text with the Psalm titles kept separate.

bsb-thiago.title: BSB in thiagobodruk/bible
bsb-thiago.lineageNote: Same revision of the BSB as our source (98.9% of verses identical). Older and newer BSB revisions (HelloAOLab/bible-api, usfm-bible/examples.bsb) are not used as witnesses: their differences are the translators' own revisions.

wcf-1649.title: The confession of faith ... (London: Robert Bostock, 1649), EEBO-TCP A80320
wcf-1649.lineageNote: Keyed transcription of a 1649 printing, in its original spelling, with the proof references as margin notes.

wcf-waller.title: andrewhwaller/westminster-json
wcf-waller.lineageNote: 'The original text of 1646 with the Assembly's proof texts included via inline citation.'
